children: Dynatrace entered into a new Credit Agreement for a senior secured revolving credit facility of up to $500 million to enhance liquidity and financial flexibility. The facility allows borrowings in U.S. dollars, Euros, Pounds Sterling, and Canadian Dollars (non-U.S. dollar borrowings capped at $100 million), with interest tied to SOFR, EURIBOR, SONIA, CORRA, or a base rate plus a margin based on leverage or credit ratings. The facility matures June 24, 2031, includes an aggregate leverage covenant of ≤4.0x (with a temporary 4.5x step-up for certain acquisitions), and provides for two optional one-year extensions with lender consent.
: Senior secured multicurrency revolving credit facility
: Bank of America, as administrative agent, and other lenders
: Through Jun 24 2031, with two optional one-year extensions
